A huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball rests on her thighs, held there by a thick chain looped around her thighs and locked with a heavy padlock. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, from each ring hangs a short thick chain ending in a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball resting on the flagstones beside that foot, the weights pulling her ankles down. Dust clings around the openings at her eyes and her lips are dry and a little cracked, and her bare feet and toes are black with grime.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in glossy jet-black latex with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy latex hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a subtly pained look, a slight furrow between her brows and her lips parted just a little, makeup: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
